Zip doc 05 recommends keeping a second model configured and tested as a fallback against model retirement.

policy.switchRule: Make GPT-6 Luna an agent's primary only when (a) a reviewed side-by-side comparison of at least 20 synthetic or approved questions, marked with the same rubric, favours it, or (b) the agent's measured bundle token count puts every Haiku 5.5 call above the 100K-token price step and Luna's verified price for that size is lower. Record the evidence next to the change. Never switch on file size or a characters/4 estimate.
policy.fallbackRule: No automatic runtime fallback. The pilot has no fallback path (handoffs). A model switch is a reviewed configuration change by website 03/Bruno.
